status_note: Manual digital review checklist. Verified means the recorded guide revision was reviewed against its sources and rendered output; it does not certify physical fit, adhesion, cable reach or powered behavior, and it does not authorize publication. Re-review affected surfaces after changes.
review_requirements: For each affected assembly view, verify actual parts, mating orientation, fastener/nut entry direction, attachment order and agreement with adjacent instructions. Check earlier access/wiring/setup supports later steps. Verify all three servo attachment/positioning requirements against supported software behavior.

surfaces.reason: Direct servo-feed wiring, F2 lighting protection and service isolation need review against the current guide and a bench walk-through. Broad guide review remains pending. Light chain rewritten after the owner bench (2026-10-06): strand factory plug kept as the body half, R2 on the base side, power and data daisy-chained to the head and mouth, one 6406 cut into the head leads, old step 33 merged into steps 28 and 33; JST-SM sockets on the base half and head light body half, pins on the strand input and head half; servo leads drawn in their real brown, red, orange order; sleeves exit on the wire axis; JST size on every connector drawing; one caption under every picture, the same wherever it is reused; drawings and renders carry labels only (no drawn titles, view lines or notes); needs review and the first all-lights test. Base wiring restructured after the owner bench (2026-10-06): layout shown before leads are cut, each tie square stuck down as its part is tied, secure-base-wiring step retired, level shifter outputs drawn and labeled, base check cut to power paths, light fuse and shorts. Pi header map after the owner bench (2026-10-07): every header row numbered from the microSD end, USB end and board edge shown, rows given for each pin, pin 1 labeled on the base with its own picture, Pi fastening leaders no longer cross. Body foam after the owner bench (2026-10-07): true-size PDF template, round 14 mm shoulder holes marked at a test-fit (no slits, windows or edge notches). Head steps after the owner bench (2026-10-07): eye cable plugged between the two eye boards before they are fastened, with its own drawing; head fastener test-fit step retired (64 build steps) and its slack check moved into the head harness step; head shelf picture marks the faces that stay up; shelf, adapter and horn named the head shelf assembly. JST-SM shapes after the owner's strand photos (2026-10-07): the pins half drawn as the larger shrouded housing with pins set inside, the sockets half as the smaller housing that slides into it, end-on mating faces added, latch drawn from the latch side, strand wires red, green and black; strand test retitled to confirm the input end chosen in the light fuse step. Master wiring Pi header after the owner's check (2026-10-07): rows were mirrored (odd pins drawn on the board-edge row); now even pins on the edge row and odd pins inner, matching the step header drawings, with the GPIO wires re-routed.
